name: Off Pool
short: Arcade pool with career halls, bosses and power-ups. 8-ball, 9-ball and more.
full:
Off Pool is an arcade pool game with a stylish neon look, built for quick matches and a long career.

Aim your cue, add spin and power, and clear the table. Play US 8-Ball, UK 8-Ball, 9-Ball and fast special rules like 3-Ball, Knockout, Rapid Fire and Rotation.

MODES
- Career: climb through 10 halls, each with its own boss and table. Beat the boss over 4 games in different rules to unlock the next hall and win power-ups.
- Quick Match: pick a table, rule set and opponent and play right away.
- Tournament: knock out your rivals in a bracket to take the trophy.
- Pro Shop: spend your winnings on cues, gloves and chalk with real stat bonuses. A tutorial teaches spin, cut shots and breaks.

FEATURES
- Realistic ball physics with spin (english), cuts and breaks
- 10 different halls and tables, a roster of opponents with their own style
- Level up, earn coins and XP, and unlock gear
- Landscape play with simple touch controls
- Watch an optional ad after a match to double your coins
- Works offline

Free to play with ads. Made by Arcadoff.
